product.name: Outbrain Direct Response
product.description: An advertising platform focused on performance marketing that uses AI-driven targeting and real-time analytics to optimize campaigns for lead generation and conversions on the open web.

product.name: Outbrain Amplify
product.description: A content promotion service that distributes branded or editorial content across premium publisher sites to increase audience reach and engagement.

product.name: Outbrain Engage
product.description: A content recommendation solution for publishers that suggests relevant articles or media to site visitors to increase engagement and pageviews.
